name: Surface of an Exoplanet
description:
Our galaxy is full of Earth-sized planets, orbiting Sun-like stars, in the habitable zone. However, none of those exoplanets have been imaged to the level where we could see their surface in detail. This artwork is an AI art impression of the surface of a hypothetical exoplanet. The AI art model imagined the details of the surface without seeing any images of exoplanets, with the help of creative algorithms and careful tuning. The first owner of the NFT will receive an extended version of the work in 4K (3840×2160) resolution.

Verisart Certified: https://verisart.com/works/leo-isikdogan-91a54

name: Las Luminarias: Old And Fearless
description: This man has ridden at Las Luminarias each year without fail for 55 years. He moved through the fires completely unwavered. His courage seemed to translate to his horse who never seemed to flinch. The fires may as well not have been there. Truly incredible scenes. 'Old and Fearless' is the sixth and final photograph from the collection. 'Las Luminarias' is a visual documentation of my time spent at this surreal, 500-year-old, rural Spanish festival.
